source: trends.google.com explore widgets (TIMESERIES multiline, GEO_MAP comparedgeo), hl=en-US, category=All, worldwide
notes: Coquette uses "coquette aesthetic": plain "coquette" is also a French/Spanish word and had a ~25% share of these six terms already in 2004, before the aesthetic existed.

Brands are search terms, each queried alone (2016-2025). Google Trends brand *topics* were tried first but had gaps and near-zero values in 2017-2020 (e.g. Dior), so they were dropped. Brands whose names are common words (Off-White, Diesel, The Row, Valentino) were left out.
